issues.what: Right (weapon-side) pauldron. The plank is gone: there is now a 52 x 49 cm stone cap over the whole shoulder, with a roundel, a lame plate under its rim and the fringe, and it rides the shoulder and arm. In the hero views it still does not read as the concept's pauldron. From the front only the 12-13 cm front face shows, half under the raised carry fist, so it reads as a short grey tube or bolster with a knob at its outer end.
issues.evidence: In attack2 and cast_a3 (three_clips_burdam_tall.png rows 1 and 4) it now reads as a pauldron cap with a lame and no longer floats. Side by side (scratchpad polish/burdam/rcap_cmp.png): the concept shows a broad layered plate about 0.32 x 0.24 m in front view, with a carved spiral roundel and the fringe below. The splash shows a grey-blue roll of about 0.31 x 0.17 m with a small boss at the end. The portrait shows a white tube with a knob under the fist. In three_burdam.png close cell 0 it is a horizontal grey bar from the cowl to the fist; in cell 1 and turntable cells 2, 7 and 8 it is a rolled bolster with the roundel at its end. The left stack still dominates, and the right shoulder reads as a roll, not a second heavy piece.
issues.fix: Give the cap a front face of at least 20-24 cm visible from the front 3/4, or a second stepped tier under it as in the concept, so its outer edge flares over the arm below the carry fist. Put the roundel on a flat, front-facing plate and make it larger (about 12 cm), not on the end of a curved roll. Let the fringe hang visibly below the lame. Check in splash, portrait and three close cells 0-1 at the lobby / idle pose.
issues.w5b: The right pauldron is now two plates: the dome over the shoulder top (front pulled back) and a separate broad FRONT PLATE (part pauldron_face, 440 tris) placed where the concept paints it (measured on the plates' 5 cm grid: x -0.49..-0.20, top 1.78, bottom 1.59). It is a flat chamfered slab, 0.33 m across and 0.20-0.25 m tall, tilted 13 degrees back. Its top edge stands 3-5 cm proud of the dome, so it reads as a layered plate. Its outer corner flares down over the arm (z 1.63). The roundel is carved into the flat face: a 12 cm ring groove round a dished centre, with painted cuts at r 2.2 / 5.0 / 6.9 cm. A raised ring and boss read as a nut or knob in build 1, so they were replaced. The face paints as the lit stone face. The fringe slats are 15 cm long and stand 2.5-4 cm off the sleeve, so about 12 cm hang below the lame (they used to sit half inside the sleeve). Evidence: splash.png / portrait.png (art/out/fighters/burdam), three_burdam.png close cells 0-1, fw_W5b_b2_poses.png (idle_lobby / idle / victory 0.92 / cast_ult f15; front, 3q, side, back, game). In every hero view the shoulder shows a flat plate with a carved ring, not a roll or knob. Concept overlay: scratchpad fw_W5b/face_overlay.png. Build: 20448 tris (+381), 1159180 B, three load OK, accent 1.71 % (top half 73.3 %), facing +Z.

issues.what: The new carry raised the blade-through-coat peak at the start of the cast_ult wind-up. It is small (2 frames, inside a clip that already clips about 0.33 s), but it is a measured regression of this pass.
issues.evidence: My burdam_audit run (cast_ult, step 1): torso hits f0-f2 = 0, f3 = 41, f4 = 41 (all coat), f5-f9 = 28-29, f10-f14 = 17-24 (the last two ranges existed before). The builder reported f4 13 -> 41.
issues.fix: Re-key the first in-betweens of cast_ult (f2-f4) so the blade first lifts up and out of the back-pointing carry (raise its elevation and pull it out from the back) before it swings into the wind-up. Target f3 and f4 at or below the earlier 13, and at or below the clip's existing f5+ range.
issues.w5b: cast_ult has a new lift key (ULT_LIFT, t 0.09, about f4). The fist rises out and up beside the back of the right shoulder (rel -0.62 / 0.35 / 0.58) while the blade still points straight back but steepens to 44 degrees (the carry is 30), and only then swings into the cocked reach. A sweep on the cached build showed that a blade leaning out or steepening to 50 degrees before the fist leaves the shoulder drives the pommel through the coat's back (50-180 verts). The swing down has a wider arc (ULT_ARC, f15), so the cleaver passes outside the new front plate. burdam_audit cast_ult --step 1, torso column (_harness/_reports/fw_W5b_burdam_audit_final.txt vs fw_W5b_burdam_audit_ult_before.txt): f3 41 -> 0, f4 41 -> 0, f5 28 -> 16, f6-f13 unchanged at 17-28, f14 11 -> 2, f15 3 -> 9, f16 7 -> 6, f17 24 -> 24, worst 41 -> 28. Stretch max 6.6 -> 6.1. Head 0.

issues.what: Taupe middle family. The belt and the cowl/cap now separate, but the chest harness straps are still in the coat's value family, where the concept has them clearly darker.
issues.evidence: three_burdam.png front close-up: coat L* 52, belt 30.5 (was 43 vs 44), strap about 56. The cap is grey (a*/b* about 0.5/0.4) against the warm cowl. In game the cowl reads cream above a dark brown coat, which is a clear split. Concept coat is L* 31 with darker straps.
issues.fix: Paint the harness straps 10-15 L* under the coat (leather #554336 range).

issues.what: Splash/portrait accent tiles. They are matte now with a dark bezel, but they are still five large saturated azure diamonds plus a big square pommel gem, and they remain the loudest element of both stills.
issues.evidence: In splash.png each diamond is about 45 px, roughly 14 cm at 323 px/m. The pommel square is about 30 px. The concept shows small gems set into the notches.
issues.fix: Use stills-only scale 0.5-0.6 and drop the emission or saturation another step; shrink the pommel square.

issues.what: Almanac belt board. The frame now reads as dark walnut and the ruled lines show, but the face is still above the brief's L* 86 ceiling.
issues.evidence: burdam_almanac_splash.png board face: median L* 89.9, p90 96 (was about 100).
issues.fix: Board page about 0.8x again, to a median of 80 or lower.

issues.what: The brief still puts the three-tier stack on the right shoulder; the concept and the model have it on the left.
issues.evidence: _design/fighters/burdam.md lines 29, 60 and 179 still say 'right pauldron is a three-tier stack' / 'Right: three overlapping tiers' / 'stacked right pauldron'.
issues.fix: Design-doc edit (outside art scope): the stack goes on the left, the roundel cap on the right.

issues.what: The three QA accent top-half share dropped after the carry change. Part of this is likely the 160 px QA crop cutting off the heel facing W/NW.
issues.evidence: build_report three_qa accentTopHalfPct: 94.2 % (pl3, commit a00371cc) -> 73.3 % (r2b). In the N and NE facings the inlays sit at the waist. In the in-game W shots the inlays sit above the HP bar.
issues.fix: Re-measure with a crop that contains the blade. If the share is still under about 90 %, accept it as the N-facing cost or move the inlays toward the heel's upper edge.

issues.what: At eye level the idle carry shows the blade as an upright, foreshortened stub behind the right shoulder, not the brief's 55-degree diagonal. The idle is now 30 degrees pointing straight back. In the product this only shows in QA views, since menus play idle_lobby.
issues.evidence: turntable.png cell 0, three_clips_burdam_tall row 9 (idle), audit idle elevation +30. src/render/menu.ts poses idle_lobby.
issues.fix: Record the game-camera rationale in the brief's §8 (idle 30 degrees back, lobby keeps the concept carry), or accept it as is.

issues.what: RIFT High clears the top-25 target by only 0.8 L*. A small lane or light change elsewhere would fail it.
issues.evidence: RIFT High top-25 70.8 (target 70). The lane is already up 37 -> 38 from another agent's lane paint.
issues.fix: Optional: lift the back of the cowl / coat shoulders (the RIFT spot sees his back) by 2-3 L* for margin, keeping cowl p90 at or under 86.

w5b_note: W5b package burdam-hesmi (2026-10-28) took 3 base builds plus a skins build. In the full burdam_audit at step 1, compared with the same clips on the pre-W5b cache, the new plate adds single mid-swing frames: victory torso worst 100 -> 117 (f9), dash 12 -> 25, idle_lobby 9 -> 12. idle and run stay at torso 0 and head 0. The minors are not addressed in this pass.
